card.name: Oncology dosing: until disease progression
card.fires_on: The word 'disease' or 'until' in 'until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity' in cancer dosing text. Also partway through chemotherapy drug names such as cisplatin, carboplatin and docetaxel.
